content: In this project, we explore the implementation of Transformer-based models (BERT and Transformer-XL) in language modeling for Finnish. We will use the same training data as in BIBREF8 so that we can do fair comparisons with the performance of the LSTM models. Also, as the BERT model is a bi-directional transformer, we will have to approximate the conditional probabilities given a sequence of words. We also experiment with using sub-word units with Transformer-XL to cope with the large vocabulary problems associated with the Finnish Language. With smaller units, the modeled sequences are longer, and we hope that the recursive XL architecture can allow us to still model long term effects.
